article.title: J Street is trying to rescue Zionism in the battle over Israel’s future in the Democratic Party
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: The contours of the battle over the future of the Democrats' policy toward Israel are starting to take shape, and J Street is trying to cement support for the existence of a Jewish ethno-state as the Party's bottom line.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
